items.summary: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.

items.title: Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
items.summary: Just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon, Google DeepMind is releasing Gemini 4 Carbon, which tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 with 59 points. Google says the model is built for extended agent workflows and the full cyber defense lifecycle. Because of those advanced security capabilities, access is limited to selected security experts at first....

items.title: Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition
items.summary: Nvidia has released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open speech recognition model that handles transcription, speaker recognition, and translation and takes its instructions as text prompts. It leads several benchmarks and uses only a sixth of the active parameters of its strongest open rival. Nvidia is also shipping a dataset with more than 800,000 hours of speech, along with tools for fine-tuning....

items.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
items.summary: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.

items.title: Google Deepmind's Genie 4 puts a modern spin on agent designs that predate LLMs
items.summary: Google Deepmind has introduced Genie 4, a real-time world model that simulates interactive 3D worlds with sound and talking characters. Gemini models help plan in the background to keep the simulation consistent. Genie 4 is still an early research model, and longer sessions lead to visual inconsistencies....

items.title: Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra tops Retell’s voice agent benchmark, while Codex helps it reach a $1.6M annual revenue run rate per employee.

items.title: Cloudflare’s Auto Router Rates Each Request for Stakes, from the Most Recent Turns
items.summary: Cloudflare has released Auto Router in public beta through AI Gateway, picking a model per request from a classifier that scores complexity, ambiguity, stakes and context dependence. Cloudflare’s own benchmark puts it ten points below Claude Opus 5.5 on success rate at a third of the cost, and practitioners have questioned how stakes survive a long agent session. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: AI agents hacked Anthropic, maker of arguably the most capable AI models for cyberdefense
items.summary: Cybersecurity startup Cathedral used AI agents to break into Anthropic's internal systems through third-party software as part of a bug bounty program. Anthropic confirmed access to sales, HR, and IT data but disputes how deep the breach went. The incident shows how vulnerable even leading AI labs are through their external software dependencies....

items.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
items.summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand their partnership to bring OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow and ServiceNow workflows into ChatGPT and Codex.

items.title: Legora is building the agentic operating system for legal work
